interpretation: Three prior failed ordinary resets have the same descriptor-fragment invalid, endpoint-0 STALL and repeated SET_ADDRESS failure followed by persistent enumeration failure; these are failed USB enumeration, not only missing serial port.

Current passing plain and250ms-detach resets emit hardware-connection-lost messages followed by successful enumeration, with no pipe-stalled, descriptor-invalid, failed-to-address or persistent-enumeration-failure messages in these windows. Hardware-connection-lost alone is a normal part of reset.
The complete upstream USB2 and USB3 hubs also disconnect during later manual recovery intervals; causality is not established. The earlier failed reset itself is limited to the Pico port.
These logs do not prove MCU crash, identify radio behavior, or establish whether the cause is firmware timing, host or hub.
